organization.name: Zendesk, Inc.
organization.parent: Investor group led by Hellman & Friedman and Permira
organization.notes: Investor-group acquisition completed November22,2022; delisted former NYSE:ZEN. Hellman & Friedman and Permira are equity owners from acquisition, not merely lenders.

pricingTiers.name: Support Team
pricingTiers.notes: Lowest paid support-only plan; $19/agent/month paid yearly multiplied by12. Omnichannel Suite is separate.

pricingTiers.name: Suite Professional
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Most Popular card; $115/agent/month paid yearly multiplied by12.

pricingTiers.name: Suite Team
pricingTiers.notes: Named Team tier; omnichannel scope exceeds Support Team. $55/agent/month paid yearly multiplied by12.

pricingTiers.name: Suite Enterprise + Copilot
pricingTiers.notes: Enterprise card directs Talk to Sales; no numerical price.

moats.claim: Broad ticketing, knowledge, voice and workflow ecosystem creates process and integration switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Omnichannel routing assigns tickets using agent capacity, skills and ticket priority.
Action Builder connects multi-step resolution flows to third-party systems.
Knowledge base and reporting bring self-service answers and operational trends into the support workflow.
